mentions.name: Lång
mentions.description: Lång is a daily spending guide app that shows what's okay to spend based on how much needs to last how long. It is designed around the instinctive approach of checking the balance and pacing spending, instead of tracking where money went and making monthly plans.
mentions.problem: Most people resist traditional money advice, which is based on seeing where money went and making monthly plans; they feel it's a poor match for how money works, so they improvise on their own by checking their balance and trying to pace things.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an app called Lång. A daily spending guide. It shows you what’s okay to spend based on how much needs to last how long.
